name: Hridaya Yoga Mexico
tradition: Hridaya lineage founded by Sahajananda (Kashmir Shaivism/Advaita Vedanta synthesis)
technique: Silent sitting meditation, heart-centered awareness practice, Hatha Yoga
retreatOptions: 3, 5, 10, 17, 28, and 49-day silent retreats, plus dark-room retreats and online options
about: Built atop a hill between Mazunte and San Agustinillo since 2012, with four yoga halls, a vegan dining hall, and eco-lodging with ocean views. Runs a well-structured on-site silent-retreat ladder from 3 days up to 49 days, plus yoga teacher trainings and separate volunteer stays; its permanent staff and year-round calendar distinguish it from a rented-villa operation.
schedule: Multiple retreats run continuously through the year
cost: Approx. $650-750 USD for a 10-day retreat (third-party aggregator estimate, not an official published rate)

pricePerDay.notes: Estimated from aggregator listings for the 10-day retreat; not directly sourced from the official site.

workNotes: Volunteering offered as a separate track, not required of retreat participants.
